<thought>To find the appropriate retrosynthetic template for the Doebner modification, I will search the template catalog using the typical product cinnamic acid (SMILES: O=C(O)C=CC1=CC=CC=C1). The forward reaction breaks an aldehyde (C=O) and forms an alkene (C=C). I will query for templates that break a carbonyl group and form an alkene, with the corresponding bond changes.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C(O)C=CC1=CC=CC=C1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aldehyde"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["alkene"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C=C"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C=O"]
}</action_input>
